title: Grand marshals, baskets and sashes
summary: Grand marshals are tall men with large baskets and sashes; Willie Hicks and Cass are their marshals.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Jazz funerals: dirges, hot return, second line

blocks.x: All of them is different. Different designs, different colors. Just like their baskets. The baskets are decorated, different they have a basket. Oh I guess it sets about that high. About three feet almost. Oh yes, some of them are so tall that guy, when he's walking he's got to hold this away. He can't hold it down. He's got to hold it up. Now mostly your marshal pretty much has the extra large basket. Your marshal of the day, I think he's the first man, that's the grand marshal. He's leading the whole procession. Well he has a great big bag, big basket and a great big fan and he's going on patting and kicking the whole thing. I just want to leave. He used to be practically a regular grand marshal. Nobody didn't run against him and they wanted him, he's tall you know. And that's the kind of man you need for a grand marshal, a tall man. Like that big fella was out there Sunday, those are the kind of fellas for grand marshal. Well we have two big fellas for the parades of marshal, Willie Hicks and his fella named Cass, they call him. He's a great big fella too. Why would you need a big fella? Well he's tall and you can see him coming. You can see him coming. That second line can't hide him.
He looks good out there. Oh he looks better good.

Yeah. And he got a dove up here or something on his shoulder and he got that sash across here. And the grand marshal has a great big sash and he got to hold it up. He's got it on his arm. Oh they wouldn't take nothing for that day.
